import_provenance.original_title: Uniform cut elimination with digging and fixed points
import_provenance.original_statement: Extend the uniform cut-elimination theorem for μsuperLL∞ to include digging rules, which permit nested exponential modalities, while retaining least and greatest fixed points and the validity condition for non-wellfounded proofs. Bauer and Saurin identify digging as the missing case in their general theorem; suitable explicit restrictions may be necessary.
